summary: Script is excellent (set -euo pipefail, quoted variables, modular functions, proper error handling, zero dependencies). Workflow is syntactically sound with good triggers, pinned actions, and job dependencies. CRITICAL GAPS: (1) No evidence actionlint was run (required validation). (2) Workflow runs script only once; doesn't structure output or test multiple scenarios as required by 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT'. (3) No act-result.txt generation shown (required artifact). (4) Workflow doesn't clearly accept test fixture data or demonstrate multiple test cases. Script is shippable; workflow+deliverable incomplete per requirements.
